headline: What Could Push ADSK Stock Higher From Here?
summary: Five years ago, Autodesk spent about $1.8 billion on a string of construction acquisitions. That bet has now compounded into a business generating almost $600 million in annual revenue. This segment is still growing north of 20%, a rate faster than the company average.

headline: Autodesk (ADSK) Joins OpenUSD Push As ISO Process Starts For 3D Standards
summary: Autodesk joined the Alliance for OpenUSD effort to drive global 3D data interoperability and agentic AI workflows. The alliance has begun the ISO certification process for the OpenUSD Core Specification 1.1. This move targets broader adoption of OpenUSD as a common 3D data layer across gaming, XR, and enterprise use cases.
